name: Manhandled With Care
source:
Manhandled With Care is a short, sexy visual novel where you get to know Gabriel, your hunky delivery man. As you go through the story, make choices to decide how you want your relationship with Gabriel to go. 

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4362860/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
Manhandled With Care是一部简短、性感的视觉小说，你可以在其中认识加布里埃尔，你的帅哥送货员。当你阅读故事时，请做出选择来决定你与加百列的关系如何发展。 

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4362860/]Steam[/url]]
